text: Based on the evidence, **yes, some native forest has been lost on this property**. A total of **13.5 hectares** of tree cover was lost in 2025, with **13.1 hectares** confirmed as native forest (97% of the loss area). The remaining 0.4 hectares were outside mapped forest zones. The loss is corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which mapped 98% of the event area as forest in 2020. While the loss represents only **3.9% of the total asset area (345.6 ha)**, it is a confirmed reduction in native forest cover. No planted forest was involved in this event.
